requirements.text: * Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical discipline, with an expected graduation date between December 2027 and May 2028\.
Due to government program requirements, candidates must be authorized to work in the United States.
Gecko Robotics is seeking a **Full Stack Software Engineering Intern** to join our Engineering team in New York for **Summer 2027**. This is a full\-time, onsite internship, Monday through Friday.
* Foundational programming experience in Python and JavaScript or TypeScript, including object\-oriented or functional programming concepts.
* Experience building a web application end to end (frontend and backend) through coursework, projects, research, hackathons, or a prior internship.
* Working familiarity with Git or similar version control systems.
* Understanding of relational databases and REST APIs.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical work, explain tradeoffs, and collaborate on ambiguous problems.
* Ability to independently close knowledge gaps, stay organized, and learn from feedback.
* Experience with React and TypeScript in a real project.
* Experience designing data schemas or working with messy, real\-world datasets.
* Exposure to cloud infrastructure, preferably GCP, and to containers such as Docker.
* Exposure to integrating LLM or other AI APIs into an application.
* Interest in 3D, visualization, or spatial data.
* Interest in industrial, defense, or infrastructure applications where reliability matters.
